mapper.select:
select c.*, (select count(*) from coupon_history ch where ch.coupon_id = c.id) as receive_count, (select count(*) from coupon_history ch where ch.coupon_id = c.id and ch.use_status = 1) as use_count from coupon c
and c.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and c.type = #{type}
order by c.create_time desc, c.id desc

select c.*, (select count(*) from coupon_history ch where ch.coupon_id = c.id) as receive_count, (select count(*) from coupon_history ch where ch.coupon_id = c.id and ch.use_status = 1) as use_count from coupon c where c.id = #{id}

select c.*, (select count(*) from coupon_history ch where ch.coupon_id = c.id) as receive_count, (select count(*) from coupon_history ch where ch.coupon_id = c.id and ch.use_status = 1) as use_count from coupon c where (c.enable_time is null or c.enable_time <= now()) and (c.end_time is null or c.end_time >= now()) and ( c.publish_count is null or (select count(*) from coupon_history ch where ch.coupon_id = c.id) < c.publish_count ) and ( c.per_limit is null or (select count(*) from coupon_history ch where ch.coupon_id = c.id and ch.member_username = #{username}) < c.per_limit ) order by c.create_time desc, c.id desc
